selected_articles.title_zh: PHASE-Tree：长程角色扮演对话中的角色状态演化建模
selected_articles.title_en: PHASE-Tree: Modeling Character-State Evolution in Long-Horizon Role-Playing Dialogue
selected_articles.authors_en: Bo Tang, Jianan Yang, Junyi Zhu, et al.
selected_articles.summary_zh: 提出多时间尺度角色状态树，以不可变身份根和可变的人格、会话及当前状态层，建模长程角色扮演中的持续演化，并通过 LongEvoRoleBench 评测演化状态下的生成能力。
selected_articles.summary_en: Introduces a multi-timescale character-state tree with an immutable identity root and mutable persona, session, and moment layers, alongside LongEvoRoleBench for evaluating evolved-state generation.

selected_articles.title_zh: 从简单到复杂：基于高斯混合模型的课程引导物理信息神经网络
selected_articles.title_en: From Simple to Complex: Curriculum-Guided Physics-Informed Neural Networks via Gaussian Mixture Models
selected_articles.authors_en: Jianan Yang, Yiran Wang, Shuai Li, et al.
selected_articles.summary_zh: 提出课程引导高斯混合物理信息神经网络 CGMPINN，根据偏微分方程残差动态识别学习难度，并由易到难调整训练重点，以改善复杂偏微分方程上的收敛与精度。
selected_articles.summary_en: Presents CGMPINN, which models spatial learning difficulty from PDE residuals and progressively shifts optimization from easier to harder regions to improve convergence and accuracy on challenging PDEs.
